tools.name: build_travel_connectivity_guide
tools.description: Creates a free, provider-neutral mobile-data estimate and readiness checklist for a travel route. Use it for trip data budgeting, hotspot planning, offline readiness, and connection fallback advice. Do not use it for a pure phone eSIM compatibility question; use check_esim_device_compatibility inste

tools.name: check_esim_device_compatibility
tools.description: Use this tool whenever the user asks whether a phone supports eSIM or is ready for a travel eSIM. Check an exact phone model against Skyalo's manufacturer-sourced compatibility catalog, including regional variants, carrier locks, EID, and Add eSIM settings. Do not call build_travel_connectivity_guid

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "build_travel_connectivity_guide" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
